name: gh-pane
description: A docked pane of the session repo's issues and PRs in run order, with buttons that fill the next command, plus two for this session's ship runs: send the merge reply at the merge gate, then, once the PR is merged there or by ship on its own, clear and run the next command.

needsTriageLabel.title: Needs-triage label
needsTriageLabel.description: The label on an issue waiting for triage.

needsInfoLabel.title: Needs-info label
needsInfoLabel.description: The label on an issue waiting for its reporter.

readyForAgentLabel.title: Ready-for-agent label
readyForAgentLabel.description: The label on an issue an agent may ship now.

readyForHumanLabel.title: Ready-for-human label
readyForHumanLabel.description: The label on an issue that needs a person.

mapLabel.title: Map label
mapLabel.description: The label on a planning map: an issue whose sub-issues are decision tickets that close without a PR.

mapCommand.title: Map command
mapCommand.description: What an open, unblocked, unclaimed map ticket's next button fills; {map} is the map's number, {n} the ticket's.

prCap.title: PR cap
prCap.description: How many open PRs the header counts against.

worktreeLayout.title: Ship worktree layout
worktreeLayout.description: Where a ship run isolates issue {n}, relative to the main checkout's parent folder: {repo} is the main checkout's folder name, {slug} any one path segment.

shipCommand.title: Ship command
shipCommand.description: What a ready issue's ship button fills; {n} is the issue number.

triageCommand.title: Triage command
triageCommand.description: What triage and triage all fill; {issues} is one number (12) or a list (#12, #13 one by one).

releaseRequest.title: Release request
releaseRequest.description: What a stale claim's release button fills; {n} is the issue number, {user} its assignees.
releaseRequest.default: Release the ship claim on #{n}: unassign {user} and comment that the claim went stale with no PR.

closeRequest.title: Close request
closeRequest.description: What an all-done issue's close button fills; {n} is the issue number, {total} its sub-issue count.
closeRequest.default: Close #{n}: all {total} of its sub-issues are closed.

gateText.title: Merge-gate text
gateText.description: The text a main-loop answer carries when this session waits at a merge gate, with the PR's link in it; it shows the merge button.

mergedText.title: Merged text
mergedText.description: The text a main-loop answer carries when a ship run merged its PR on its own, with the PR's link after it on the same line (only its first occurrence counts); once the PR reads merged, it shows the next button.

mergeReply.title: Merge reply
mergeReply.description: The reply the merge button sends at the gate, and the typed reply that counts as the same.

buttonIcon.title: Band button icon
buttonIcon.description: What follows Open gh-pane or Hide gh-pane on the button above the prompt. The default is the GitHub mark of a Nerd Font (U+F408); leave it empty where the terminal's font has no Nerd Font glyphs.
